title: 第4189章 监正贺西洲第4188章 猛龙过江
content_zh:
红尘皇城。
远道而来的李子夜和太商做客钦天监，策师平天策亲自相迎，场面是那样的和谐。
一座不算太大的小院中，平天策非常热情地为两人安排好起居的客房，虽然，钦天监原则上不允许外人进入，但是，原则归原则，有时候，稍微变通一下，原则便不复存在。
“二牛兄，上次你走的太急，我甚至没有来得及对你说一声感谢。”
房间内，平天策看着眼前年轻人，客气地说道，“这一次，二牛兄一定要在皇城这边多待一些日子，好让在下尽一尽地主之谊。”
“那就叨扰天策兄了。”
李子夜一脸谦逊地应了一句，想了想，上前一步，低声叮嘱道，“天策兄，我的身份，你能不能暂时先替我保密，你也知道，一旦我的身份暴露，肯定会引来很多不必要的麻烦。”
平天策听过前者之言，犹豫了一下，点头应道，“可以倒是可以，只是，万一监正大人问起，我也不能刻意隐瞒。”
“理解。”
李子夜说道，“只要天策兄不主动向外说，就行。”
监正？
那位大天尊都昏过去了，还问什么。
随后，各怀心思的两人，又随便扯了几句，话题都没有太多营养，无非是上一次，李子夜从天而降后，又突然离开，究竟是去了哪里。
李子夜当然不会实话实说，先前他回了一趟九州，而是随口胡诌道，他上次为了躲避那些大天尊的追杀，在南天门各地到处流浪，狼狈躲了好一阵子。
“原来如此。”
平天策听过眼前年轻人的解释，感叹道，“前不久，皇主闭关，监正大人亦有要事在身，那两位大天尊方才敢在皇城上方显圣，现在，皇主已经出关，二牛兄无需再担惊受怕了。”
“那可真是太好了。”
李子夜应了一句，有些好奇地问道，“对了，天策兄，先前，我来的时候，看到好几位身着皇室服饰的人一同来了皇城，是发生了什么事吗？”
“确实有大事要发生。”
平天策点头应道，“皇主，这几天决定册封太子，所以，很多皇室成员都陆陆续续从各地赶了回来，准备见证这一盛事。”

“册封太子？”
李子夜闻言，心中一惊，问道，“先前不是说，要册封四公主为皇女吗，为何，突然变了主意？”
皇女和太子，都是皇主之位下一代的候选人，一般只会有一个，红尘皇主此举，难不成是放弃了红拂？
“具体情况，我也不太清楚。”
平天策轻叹道，“不过，皇主要册封太子的事，已经定了下来，而且，就在这几天。”
“哪位皇子要被封为太子？”李子夜沉声问道。
“目前，大皇子和七皇子的呼声最高。”
平天策回答道，“至于皇主最后会册封哪位皇子为太子，只能过几日才能知道。”
“大皇子和七皇子？”
李子夜听到这两个人选，面露思绪之色。
这可不是什么好事啊。
原本，红拂作为皇女的候选人，在整个红尘皇朝的地位都称得上举足轻重，如今，红尘皇朝要册封太子，那红拂，就不可能再成为皇女，如此一来，红拂的地位必定会一落千丈，今后，在红尘皇朝的话语权，也会随之迅速下降。
要不，他将那什么大皇子和七皇子全都做掉，帮红拂一把？
一旁，太商似是看到了某人的想法，却没有挑明，目光看向外面，冷冷一笑。
来了？
content_en:
The Imperial City of Red Dust.
Li Ziye and Taishang came all the way to visit Qin Tianjian, and their planner Ping Tiance personally greeted them. The scene was so harmonious.
In a small courtyard that is not too big, Ping Tiance enthusiastically arranged a living room for the two of them. Although in principle, Qin Tian Prison does not allow outsiders to enter, but principles are principles. Sometimes, with a slight modification, principles no longer exist.
"Brother Erniu, you left too quickly last time and I didn't even have time to say thank you."
In the room, Ping Tiance looked at the young man in front of him and said politely, "This time, Brother Erniu must stay in the imperial city for a longer period of time so that I can fulfill my duty as a landlord."
"Then I'll bother Brother Tiance."
Li Ziye responded humbly, thought for a moment, stepped forward, and whispered, "Brother Tiance, can you keep my identity a secret for the time being? You also know that once my identity is exposed, it will definitely cause a lot of unnecessary trouble."
Ping Tiance heard what the former said, hesitated for a moment, nodded and said, "It's okay, but if Master Jianzheng asks, I can't deliberately hide it."
"Understood."
Li Ziye said, "As long as Brother Tiance doesn't take the initiative to tell anyone, that's fine."
Supervise?
The Great Heavenly Lord had already fainted, why did he ask any more questions.
Afterwards, the two people, who had their own thoughts, chatted a few words casually, but the topic was not very nutritious. It was just about the last time Li Ziye fell from the sky and left suddenly. Where did he go?
Of course, Li Ziye would not tell the truth. He had returned to Kyushu before, but he had casually said that in order to avoid the pursuit of the Great Heavenly Lord, he wandered around the Nantianmen and hid in embarrassment for a long time.
"That's it."
Ping Tiance listened to the explanation of the young man in front of him and sighed, "Not long ago, the emperor was in seclusion, and Master Jianzheng also had important matters. Only then did the two great gods dare to show their holiness above the imperial city. Now, the emperor has come out of seclusion, and Brother Erniu no longer needs to be frightened."
"That would be great."
Li Ziye responded and asked curiously, "By the way, brother Tiance, when I came here earlier, I saw several people in royal costumes coming to the imperial city together. Did something happen?"
"Something really big is going to happen."
Ping Tiance nodded and said, "Your Majesty, you have decided to enthrone the crown prince in the past few days. Therefore, many members of the royal family have rushed back from various places to prepare to witness this grand event."
"Canonize the crown prince?"
Hearing this, Li Ziye was shocked and asked, "Didn't you say before that you would make the fourth princess a princess? Why did you suddenly change your mind?"
The princess and the prince are both candidates for the next generation of emperor, and usually there will only be one. Could it be that by this move of Emperor Hongchen, he gave up on Hongfu?
"I don't know the specific situation."
Ping Tiance sighed lightly, "However, the emperor's decision to enthrone the crown prince has been decided, and it will be in these few days."
"Which prince will be crowned prince?" Li Ziye asked in a deep voice.
"Currently, the eldest prince and the seventh prince have the highest voices."
Ping Tiance replied, "As for which prince the emperor will finally confer as the crown prince, we can only know in a few days."
"The eldest prince and the seventh prince?"
Li Ziye looked thoughtful when he heard these two candidates.
This is not a good thing.
Originally, Hongfu, as a candidate for the imperial daughter, had a very important position in the entire Hongchen Dynasty. Now that the Hongchen Dynasty wants to confer the crown prince, Hongfu will no longer be able to become the princess. As a result, Hongfu's status will definitely plummet, and from now on, her right to speak in the Hongchen Dynasty will also decrease rapidly.
How about he kill all those eldest princes and seventh princes and give Hong a hand?
On the side, Taishang seemed to have seen someone's thoughts, but he did not express them clearly. He looked outside and smiled coldly.
Coming?
